title: 第25章
content:
短暂的叙旧结束。两人陷入沉默当中。至于秦姝，则是跟另外一个男生激烈的讨论着什么。想必应该就是天天发信息骚扰她的男生了。可当林枫一瞧见这个男生，他的眉头就皱了起来。黄毛？这可不是什么好印象。他带着藤藤蛇，快步向着两人走去。...“秦姝，你放弃吧，你的杰尼龟是打不过妙蛙种子的。”张小明甩了甩自己得意的黄色刘海，以为这样动作的自己很帅。两人已经进行过一场宝可梦对战了，虽然差不多是同一时间获取的第一只初始宝可梦，但他很清楚那只杰尼龟的缺点。水枪软弱无力，不可能对妙蛙种子造成伤害。至于另外一个撞击...就更有意思了，连头都不敢抬起来。这样的撞击，可能也就铁甲蛹躲不过去了。秦姝狠狠的瞪了他一眼，“张小明，还没开打，谁输谁赢还不一定呢。”张小明眼睛一转，不知道闪烁着什么样的光芒，“秦姝，既然你这么自信的话，那我们来打个赌怎么样，只要你输了，就当我女朋友。”“你！”秦姝更加生气了，她就算再憨，也不会答应这要求。可一下子被气愤充满了脑袋，完全不知道说些什么好。“你要是发情了就去蹭蹭树，别搞得人尽皆知，这不是什么好宣传的事情。”就在她不知道说些什么的时候，一道清亮的声音在她身边响起。林枫将手落在秦姝的头上，大步站了出来，一脸冷漠的看着眼前的黄毛。刚刚的对话，他可是全部听在耳朵中，原本以为只是正常的追求关系，现在看起来像是骚扰了。因此他第一时间赶了过来。“枫哥！就是他！”见到林枫走过来帮她说话，秦姝好像是看到了家长过来一般眼睛亮了起来。在她的印象中，小时候被人欺负，只要找林枫，那就绝对能解决！不管是吵架还是打架，他就没输过！就是在她缺理的时候，林枫也会倒过来教训她罢了。

张小明听到这话，一下子还没反应过来，等反应过来后，一张脸顿时涨红了起来，“你是谁？”“傻鸟。”林枫没有任何解释，而是看向秦姝，“像这种人，以后你根本不用搭理他，什么联系方式，删了就好，班群里面也直接拉黑。”他在教这个单纯的姑娘学会拒绝人。“嗯嗯！”秦姝小鸡啄米一样点头。从小，林枫的身上就有一种“大人”的这种气质，再加上小时候，常常帮她收拾烂摊子，久而久之，她就很听林枫的话了。“你！”被如此羞辱，张小明顿时怒火飙升，可恰巧这个时候，比赛的举办方已经带着执法人员出来，他只能打碎了牙齿往肚子里面咽，一时间头晕目眩。...“各位年轻的新人训练家们，大家好，我是旺旺超市在梧桐市的总经理池衡...为了感谢各位对旺旺超市的大力支持，我们特意联合了梧桐市电视台的对战频道，对这场比赛进行实时全场直播....”“藤藤....”（他话好多....）很显然，台上的旺旺超市老板过于繁琐的讲话，让藤藤蛇感觉到有些厌烦了。“这叫增强影响力。”林枫小声的为藤藤蛇解释。不过，根据已知的信息，他倒是能猜出为什么今年暑假结束后，会特意举办这样一个宝宝杯了。这不就是父亲为自己的孩子造势吗？联合宝可梦联盟分部，又请了电视台全场直播。这是想要打造一个极其优秀的新人天才训练家？“哎，有钱有背景就是好呀，路都给人家铺好了。”林枫也不由得为之感慨一声，不过他也不羡慕。毕竟，他已经有了这世界上最大的“背景”。约莫十分钟后，上面的地中海男人终于将话说完，“好，现在请大家上大巴，我们去往梧桐市区的体育竞技场进行这次的宝宝杯。”众人这才纷纷松了一口气，走上大巴车。林枫看了一眼，

The brief reminiscence is over.The two fell into silence.As for Qin Shu, she was having a heated discussion with another boy.It must be the boy who sends messages to harass her every day.But when Lin Feng saw this boy, his brows wrinkled.Yellow hair?That's not a good impression.He took the Vine Snake and walked quickly towards the two of them...."Qin Shu, give up, your Squirtle can't beat Bulbasaur." Zhang Xiaoming shook his proud yellow bangs, thinking that he looked handsome in this way.The two have already had a Pokémon battle. Although they obtained the first starter Pokémon at about the same time, he is very aware of the shortcomings of that Squirtle.Water Gun is weak and cannot harm Bulbasaur.As for the other impact... it was even more interesting. I didn't even dare to raise my head.Even the armored chrysalis might not be able to avoid such an impact.Qin Shu glared at him fiercely, "Zhang Xiaoming, the fight hasn't started yet, we don't know who will win yet." Zhang Xiaoming rolled his eyes, and he didn't know what kind of light was shining, "Qin Shu, since you are so confident, how about we make a bet. As long as you lose, you will be my girlfriend." "You!" Qin Shu became even more angry. No matter how stupid she was, she would not agree to this request.But my head was suddenly filled with anger, and I didn't know what to say at all."If you are in heat, just go and rub against the tree. Don't make it known to everyone. This is not something that is easy to publicize." Just when she didn't know what to say, a clear voice sounded beside her.Lin Feng placed his hand on Qin Shu's head, strode forward, and looked at Huang Mao in front of him with an indifferent expression.He heard the whole conversation just now. He originally thought it was just a normal pursuit of a relationship, but now it seems like harassment.So he rushed over immediately."Brother Feng! That's him!" Seeing Lin Feng come over to help her speak, Qin Shu's eyes lit up as if she saw a parent coming over.In her impression, if she was bullied as a child, she would definitely be able to solve it if she just went to Lin Feng!No matter it was a quarrel or a fight, he never lost!Even when she was unreasonable, Lin Feng would teach her a lesson.

When Zhang Xiaoming heard this, he didn't react for a while. When he reacted, his face suddenly turned red, "Who are you?" "Silly bird." Lin Feng didn't give any explanation, but looked at Qin Shu, "You don't have to deal with people like this in the future. Just delete their contact information and block them in the class." He was teaching this simple girl how to reject people."Yeah!" Qin Shu nodded like a chicken pecking at rice.Lin Feng has had an "adult" temperament in her since she was a child. In addition, she often helped her clean up her messes when she was a child. Over time, she listened to Lin Feng's words."You!" Being so humiliated, Zhang Xiaoming's anger suddenly soared. But at this time, the organizer of the competition had already brought out the law enforcement officers. He could only break his teeth and swallow it in his stomach, feeling dizzy for a while...."Hello to all young new trainers, I am Chi Heng, the general manager of Want Want Supermarket in Wutong City... In order to thank you for your strong support to Want Want Supermarket, we have specially joined forces with the Wutong City TV station's battle channel to broadcast the game live in real time..." "Teng Teng..." (He talks a lot...) Obviously, the owner of Want Want Supermarket on the stage made Teng Teng Snake feel a little bored with his overly cumbersome speech."This is called enhancing influence." Lin Feng explained in a low voice to Teng Teng Snake.However, based on the known information, he can guess why such a baby cup will be held after the summer vacation this year.Isn't this just a father creating momentum for his child?The joint Pokémon League branch also invited a TV station to broadcast the entire event live.Are you trying to create an extremely good new talent trainer?"Hey, it's good to have money and background. The roads are paved for others." Lin Feng couldn't help but sigh for it, but he wasn't envious either.After all, he already has the biggest "background" in the world.About ten minutes later, the Mediterranean man above finally finished his words, "Okay, now everyone please get on the bus. We will go to the sports arena in Wutong City for this Baby Cup." Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and got on the bus.Lin Feng took a look and said,
